newsitem.title: CANADA: Greenstone discovers new Honduras gold.
newsitem.headline: Greenstone discovers new Honduras gold.

text.p: Greenstone Resources Ltd said on Monday that exploration drilling at its San Andres property in Honduras has discovered a major new bulk mineable gold prospect near its Water Tank Hill deposit.
The size of the new prospect, called Twin Hills, has not yet been determined but could exceed the one-million ounce reserve at Water Tank Hill, Greenstone said in a statement.
The company said it has drilled 26 holes in the Twin Hills prospect, outlining an area 750 metres by 300 metres, which is open in three directions.
"When we initiated this exploration program, we did not expect to discover such an extensive and consistently mineralized system," said Greenstone president Rudi Fronk.
"We are now rethinking final design of the Water Tank Hill project facilities with the objective of increasing the planned production rate up to 200,000 ounces of gold per year."
